name: School Memories Reversible
original_name: スクールメモリーズ Reversible
source:
It was a warm December in Shinfuyumachi.
Souta Hirama was in his graduation year, and his mind was on
the coming semester as winter vacation approached.

He passed the time making Christmas party plans with friends,
for which he was beginning to make a Santa costume.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE180923.html]DLsite English[/url]]
